items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-dualizing, with f^!_new and omega_X^bullet defined for all schemes of finite type over S, the lemma asserts six properties: the functors f^!_new with the arrows (g o f)^!_new -> f^!_new o g^!_new form a pseudo functor on D^+_Coh; omega_X^bullet = (X -> S)^!_new omega_S^bullet; the functor D_X is an involution exchanging bounded above and below and fixing the bounded objects; omega_X^bullet = f^!_new omega_Y^bullet; f^!_new M = D_X(Lf^*D_Y(M)); and for proper f the functor f^!_new is the restriction of the right adjoint of Rf_* with the two displayed isomorphisms; finally, for separated X and f between separated schemes, omega_X^bullet = (X -> S)^! omega_S^bullet and f^!_new K = f^!K (statement lines 5587-5634). Part (1) reduces to the commutativity of a square for three composable morphisms, which is checked by writing both arrows as the same composition of the canonical isomorphisms eta_Y and eta_Z of Lemma labelled lemma-dualizing-schemes, using Categories, Lemma labelled categories-lemma-properties-2-cat-cats, with one computation marked omitted but its result displayed (proof lines 5636-5662). Parts (2) and (4) are immediate from the definition and D_S(omega_S^bullet) = O_S, part (3) is Lemma labelled lemma-dualizing-schemes and part (5) is the definition (proof lines 5664-5668). Part (6) is the substantive step: since X and Y need not be separated over S one cannot apply Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-via-duality directly, so the proof uses the identification omega_X^bullet = a(omega_Y^bullet) of Lemma labelled lemma-proper-map-good-dualizing-complex and applies Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-via-duality to f over the base scheme Y, which shows that f^!_new is the restriction of the right adjoint a, and the displayed equalities then follow from Example labelled example-iso-on-RSheafHom-noetherian (proof lines 5670-5684). The final assertions follow from the construction of normalised dualizing complexes and the same shriek-via-duality lemma (proof lines 5684-5686). Getting around the missing separatedness hypothesis by changing the base to Y is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
